title: DeerFlow — Super-agent harness that saves hours
description:
DeerFlow coordinates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes so deep research and coding that used to take hours happens in minutes. It's a free, self-hosted alternative to ChatGPT Enterprise for agent workflows.
